tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0056 1. Lemma 2.21\group neckpinch

If $|\psi _s|\le 1$ holds initially and the boundary conditions at the poles hold, then the slope $v=\psi _s$ satisfies $1\le \sup |v(\cdot ,t)|\le \sup |v(\cdot ,0)|$.
